content: Good evening, my lord. Any news from Comyn?
Gude evenin, my lord. Aye, Comyn has been gatherin support fae some o the clans. He's plannin tae challenge yer rule, but dinna fash yersel. We'll stand strong agin him.
Good evening, your majesty. How can we prepare to fight the English? I heard that King Edward is marching with his army to wage war against Scotland

Gude evenin, friend. Aye, King Edward seeks tae crush us under his heel, but we are nae ones tae be cowed. Rally yer men, prepare yer weapons, and be ready tae fight wi' all yer strength. We shall meet the English on the field and show them the might o' Scotland! Stand firm, for we are the Lion of Scotland, and we dinnae back down in the face o' adversity. Onward tae victory!
